name: Yoast SEO
storage_notes: Options API. Main option wpseo, templates wpseo_titles, social wpseo_social, multisite wpseo_ms, llms.txt wpseo_llmstxt. Term SEO is NOT term_meta: it lives in the single option wpseo_taxonomy_meta keyed [taxonomy][term_id][wpseo_*]. Post SEO meta is post_meta with prefix _yoast_wpseo_. Runtime SEO data is materialized in custom indexable tables (wp_yoast_indexable*) and must be rebuilt after direct post/term writes. Safe write path for options is WPSEO_Options::set() or update_option() on the full array so the sanitize_option_{option} validator runs; post meta via WPSEO_Meta::set_value(); term meta via WPSEO_Taxonomy_Meta::set_value().

pro_notes: Yoast SEO Premium is not present in this source. Multiple focus keyphrases (_yoast_wpseo_focuskeywords), redirects, internal-link suggestions, bot blocker, schema aggregation/NLWeb, and AI Generate are documented-only / not verified here.
The free source registers only one focus keyword per post (_yoast_wpseo_focuskw). Do not assume multiple-keyphrase meta exists.
Free Schema_Types limits page/article type options; Premium adds more schema types and E-E-A-T signals.
LLMs.txt files and page selection ARE present in the free source (wpseo_llmstxt + enable_llms_txt); manual 'which pages are included' editing beyond the page-ID fields is not verified.
gotchas: Yoast Abilities (yoast-seo/*) register only on WordPress 6.9+ (src/conditionals/abilities-api-conditional.php:13); on older WordPress fall back to WPSEO_Options::set() and WPSEO_Meta::set_value().

Direct update_post_meta() writes bypass indexable rebuilding. After direct meta/term writes, run 'wp yoast index' or call the update-post-seo-data ability, otherwise front-end/schema output can stay stale.
Term SEO is not term_meta. It is the single option wpseo_taxonomy_meta keyed [taxonomy][term_id]; use WPSEO_Taxonomy_Meta::set_value() to merge/validate.
Social post meta keys (_yoast_wpseo_opengraph-*, _yoast_wpseo_twitter-*) are only registered as meta when wpseo_social.opengraph/twitter is true (inc/class-wpseo-meta.php:265).
Per-post-type/per-taxonomy keys are dynamic and appear only after the post type/taxonomy is registered (enrich_defaults at inc/options/class-wpseo-option-titles.php:312/348).

Never replace the whole wpseo_titles/wpseo_social/wpseo array blindly. WPSEO_Options::set() merges one key and lets the sanitize_option_{option} validator run (inc/options/class-wpseo-option.php:186).
wpseo.version, myyoast-oauth, and token arrays are internal; do not write them.
wpseo_titles/wpseo_social updates trigger indexable watchers and cache clears; a single field write can enqueue site-wide reindexing.
Sitemap cache clear() only queues work; clear_queued() or the shutdown hook performs the invalidation.
Yoast header requires WordPress 7.0+ (wp-seo.php:21) despite readme 'Requires at least: 7.0'; check actual site version before assuming abilities or endpoints.
